cues.en: Hello and welcome back.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today we're talking about the R squared.
cues.zh: 今天談 R 平方。

cues.en: A very important concept when it comes to evaluating the goodness of fit of our models.
cues.zh: 評估模型擬合優度時，非常重要的概念。

cues.en: Now, in order to understand R squared, we're going to need to look at two versions of our chart.
cues.zh: 要理解 R 平方，需要看兩個版本的圖。

cues.en: So, here is our dataset, and what we're going to do here is plot the regression as we were doing before.
cues.zh: 這是資料集，這邊像之前一樣畫迴歸。

cues.en: And here's our dataset again.
cues.zh: 這裡也是同一資料集。

cues.en: And this time we're going to just plot an average line, and we'll see that in a second.
cues.zh: 但這次只畫平均值直線，稍後會看到。

cues.en: So, we'll start with the regression.
cues.zh: 先從迴歸開始。

cues.en: Let's draw our regression line.
cues.zh: 畫出迴歸直線。

cues.en: As usual, let's project vertically our data points onto it.
cues.zh: 照慣例，將資料點垂直投影到線上。

cues.en: And for each data point, we're going to look at the difference between Yi, the actual value and Yi hat, the predicted value.
cues.zh: 每個資料點，都看實際值 yᵢ 與預測值 ŷᵢ 的差異。

cues.en: Now, as we discussed before, the way we built this line is we are minimizing this sum over here, and that is the ordinary least squares method.
cues.zh: 如前所述，建立這條線的方法，是最小化這個總和，也就是普通最小平方法。

cues.en: Well, actually this sum has a name.
cues.zh: 這個總和其實有名稱。

cues.en: It's called the residual sum of squares, and it's indicated by this abbreviation.
cues.zh: 稱為殘差平方和，用這個縮寫表示。

cues.en: Now, on the right here we're going to draw an average line.
cues.zh: 右邊則畫平均值直線。

cues.en: And this is simply taking all of the Y values.
cues.zh: 只是取所有 Y 值。

cues.en: So, the actual values of our dataset, the Y values, and taking their average.
cues.zh: 也就是資料集實際 Y 值的平均。

cues.en: Again, we're going to project vertically our data points onto this line.
cues.zh: 同樣將資料點垂直投影到線上。

cues.en: And for each data point, we're going to look at Yi.
cues.zh: 對每個點，考慮 yᵢ。

cues.en: And here we're going to calculate another total.
cues.zh: 再計算另一個總和。

cues.en: And this one is called the total sum of squares and is indicated by this abbreviation.
cues.zh: 稱為總平方和，用這個縮寫表示。

cues.en: And it's similar to the residual sum of squares, but instead of using Yi hat, we're looking at the difference between Yi, the actual value
cues.zh: 與殘差平方和類似，但不用 ŷᵢ，而是看實際值 yᵢ，

cues.en: and Y average, the average value of our dataset.
cues.zh: 與資料集平均值 ȳ 的差異。

cues.en: And now we can calculate R squared.
cues.zh: 現在可以算 R 平方。

cues.en: R squared is defined as 1 minus the ratio between the residual sum of squares and the total sum of squares.
cues.zh: 定義為 1 減去殘差平方和除以總平方和。

cues.en: Now, let's pause here for a second and discuss this a bit.
cues.zh: 暫停一下，討論這個公式。

cues.en: So, we know that we're minimizing the residual sum of squares.
cues.zh: 知道我們在最小化殘差平方和。

cues.en: We wanna make it as small as possible.
cues.zh: 希望越小越好。

cues.en: And from these two images, you can already see just by judging based on the the lengths of these blue dotted, blue dashed lines,
cues.zh: 從兩張圖的藍色虛線長度，

cues.en: we can see that they're generally longer on the right where the average is, and they're shorter where the regression is.
cues.zh: 就能看出右邊平均值的線段通常更長，左邊迴歸較短。

cues.en: And that's because we've designed our line to minimize these lengths, so the sum of square is smaller.
cues.zh: 因為這條迴歸線就是為了最小化距離，所以平方和較小。

cues.en: And so, what that means is that the residual sum of squares is usually, in most cases, it's less than the total sum of squares.
cues.zh: 這表示殘差平方和通常、多數情況下小於總平方和。

cues.en: So, the way to think about it is in the total sum of squares on the right.
cues.zh: 可以這樣想，右邊總平方和，

cues.en: You're just putting an average line.
cues.zh: 只畫平均值直線。

cues.en: You're not modeling anything.
cues.zh: 沒有真正建模。

cues.en: This is the most rudimentary thing that we can do, is just put our average line and approximate our data with that average line.
cues.zh: 這是最基本的做法，用平均值直線近似資料。

cues.en: Of course it will be and it should be worse than any thought out model that we create, which is the example on the left.
cues.zh: 當然應該比左邊經過設計的模型差。

cues.en: So thereby, unless our regression model is facing the absolutely the wrong way, for example, a downward slope on the left over here.
cues.zh: 所以除非迴歸模型方向完全錯誤，例如左邊反而向下傾斜，

cues.en: If our model was sloping downwards, then the residual sum of squares would be huge because our model's just incorrect.
cues.zh: 那樣殘差平方和會很大，因為模型不正確。

cues.en: But in all other cases, the residual sum of squares is less than the total sum of squares.
cues.zh: 講者表示，其他情況下殘差平方和都小於總平方和。

cues.en: And what that means is that the ratio is less than one.
cues.zh: 所以比值小於 1。

cues.en: So, R squared is somewhere between zero and one.
cues.zh: R 平方就介於 0、1。

cues.en: And the better our model fits the data, the smaller the residual sum squares will be.
cues.zh: 模型越能擬合資料，殘差平方和越小。

cues.en: And that means the greater R squared will be.
cues.zh: 因此 R 平方越大。

cues.en: So, here's a quick rule of thumb for R squared.
cues.zh: 這裡提供快速經驗法則。

cues.en: Now, bear in mind that it highly depends on the context.
cues.zh: 但要記得，非常取決於情境。

cues.en: And this rule of thumb is just for the practical tutorials that we're looking at in this section of the course.
cues.zh: 這些只是本節實作案例的經驗判斷。

cues.en: And here we go.
cues.zh: 如下。

cues.en: So, if you have a 1, R squared of 1, that's a perfect fit.
cues.zh: R 平方是 1，表示完美擬合。

cues.en: That means the residual sum of squares is zero.
cues.zh: 也就是殘差平方和為 0。

cues.en: And basically your line is going through all the data points, which is virtually impossible, so it's very suspicious.
cues.zh: 基本上直線通過所有資料點，幾乎不可能，所以很可疑。

cues.en: If your R squared is about 0.9, that's a very good model.
cues.zh: R 平方約 0.9，模型非常好。

cues.en: If your R square is less than 0.7, it's not a great model.
cues.zh: 低於 0.7，不算很好。

cues.en: It's not the end of the world, but not great.
cues.zh: 不是無可救藥，但不理想。

cues.en: If it's less than 0.4, it's quite a terrible model.
cues.zh: 低於 0.4，相當差。

cues.en: And if it's less than zero, then the model makes no sense for this data as we discussed.
cues.zh: 小於 0，則如剛才所說，模型不適合這些資料。

cues.en: So, there we go. That's how the R squared works.
cues.zh: 這就是 R 平方的運作。

cues.en: A very important concept to understand because it's used quite a lot to evaluate models.
cues.zh: 很重要，因為經常用來評估模型。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you next time.
cues.zh: 期待下次見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受機器學習的樂趣吧。
